description: A milk tea shop owner would like to sell two different milk teas: black milk tea and matcha milk tea. Each contains both milk and honey. A bottle of black milk tea contains 600 grams of milk and 10 grams of honey, whereas a bottle of matcha milk tea contains 525 grams of milk and 5 grams of honey. The profit from each bottle of black milk tea sold is $7.5 and the profit from each bottle of matcha milk tea sold is $5. If his total production must not exceed his available stock of 30000 grams of milk and 500 grams of honey, how many bottles of each type of milk tea should be made to maximize profits?

NumMilkTeaTypes.definition: Number of different milk tea types to be produced

NumResources.definition: Number of different resources used in production

ResourceUsage.definition: Amount of resource i required to produce one bottle of milk tea type j

ProfitPerBottle.definition: Profit earned from selling one bottle of milk tea type j

AvailableResource.definition: Total available amount of resource i

objective.description: "Maximize the total profit from producing and selling black milk tea and matcha milk tea bottles"

constraints.description: The total amount of milk used for black and matcha milk tea production should not exceed 30000 grams
The total amount of honey used for black and matcha milk tea production should not exceed 500 grams
The number of bottles of each milk tea type produced must be non-negative

NumBottles.definition: Number of bottles produced for each type of milk tea
